reconstruction_note: registry/skills.json was not supplied with the package. Skill ids S01-S28 are fixed by the agent registry. Names for S01-S11 follow the admitted sources named in the build prompt; names for S12-S28 follow, in order, the list of new specialisms in section 6 of the build prompt (evidence/lineage; requirements/acceptance; AI responsibility allocation; retrieval/context; tool/permission boundaries; evaluation planning, data, execution; cost/latency; rollout/operations; outcome analysis; adversarial challenge; adjudication; delegated authority; security/privacy; controlled learning; accessible interactions). The mapping was cross-checked against which roles reference each id.

naming.constraints: Agent Skills spec: 1-64 chars, lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens; name must match its directory.

skills.name: discovery-interrogation
skills.title: Discovery interrogation
skills.summary: Reconstruct the problem from supplied context, then ask only the questions whose answers would change direction, scope, risk handling or success measures.

skills.name: corpus-grounded-onboarding
skills.title: Corpus-grounded onboarding
skills.summary: Build a structured model of a product, repository or document set, separating stated facts, strong inferences and unverified assumptions before acting.

skills.name: ux-direction-synthesis
skills.title: UX direction synthesis
skills.summary: Turn discovery answers into a mental model, surface map, priority flows and principles, with trust and control decisions made explicit.

skills.name: context-files-architecture
skills.title: Context-files architecture
skills.summary: Decide what belongs in root guidance, host-specific guidance, specialist roles, commands and skills, and keep the result layered and maintainable.

skills.name: structural-integrity-audit
skills.title: Structural integrity audit
skills.summary: Audit a set of artifacts for role clarity, duplication, contradiction, portability, bloat and filler, and return prioritized structural fixes with a readiness verdict.

skills.name: research-consolidation
skills.title: Research consolidation
skills.summary: Run staged research: inventory, extraction, consolidation, synthesis and verification, preserving provenance and keeping conflicts and uncertainty visible.

skills.name: drift-and-regression-audit
skills.title: Drift and regression audit
skills.summary: Compare a baseline and a changed artifact against declared invariants and allowed deltas; classify exact parity, intentional change, ambiguity, regression and hidden drift.

skills.name: milestone-planning
skills.title: Milestone planning
skills.summary: Break approved work into bounded work orders with scope, dependencies, write sets, acceptance checks and the evidence each must produce.

skills.name: scoped-implementation
skills.title: Scoped implementation
skills.summary: Implement one authorized work order with the smallest safe diff, run the targeted checks, and report exact files, checks, receipts and residual risks.

skills.name: independent-audit
skills.title: Independent audit
skills.summary: Verify a frozen artifact against its actual acceptance criteria in a fresh context; re-run or replay checks; return pass, fail or blocked with evidence.

skills.name: status-handoff
skills.title: Status handoff
skills.summary: Produce a short, current, derived status brief: state, latest validated progress, blockers with next actions, and the immediate queue.

skills.name: evidence-and-lineage
skills.title: Evidence and lineage
skills.summary: Record sources, claims and immutable versions with scope and limitations; type claims as fact, hypothesis or observation; link evidence to what depends on it.

skills.name: requirements-and-acceptance
skills.title: Requirements and acceptance
skills.summary: Write atomic, versioned requirements that preserve source intent and open decisions, and map each to observable checks including negative and refusal cases.

skills.name: ai-responsibility-allocation
skills.title: AI responsibility allocation
skills.summary: Decide per step whether fixed code, model inference, adaptive investigation or a human decision is responsible, and justify any adaptive behavior.

skills.name: retrieval-and-context-contracts
skills.title: Retrieval and context contracts
skills.summary: Specify how a feature acquires permitted information: authorization before exposure, scope that survives transformation, freshness, context assembly and failure tests.

skills.name: tool-and-permission-boundaries
skills.title: Tool and permission boundaries
skills.summary: Define typed tool contracts, idempotency, timeouts, failure policy, and the enforceable boundary between proposed and executed actions.

skills.name: evaluation-planning
skills.title: Evaluation planning
skills.summary: Freeze task metrics, failure slices, thresholds and baselines before results exist; disclose any later change as a decision, not a retroactive pass.

skills.name: evaluation-data-curation
skills.title: Evaluation data curation
skills.summary: Build representative, permissioned, versioned evaluation sets with development and held-out splits and explicit sampling limits.

skills.name: evaluation-execution-and-receipts
skills.title: Evaluation execution and receipts
skills.summary: Run checks and evaluations against frozen versions and record commands, exit status, logs, data and configuration versions; label fixture replay distinctly from live execution.

skills.name: cost-and-latency-analysis
skills.title: Cost and latency analysis
skills.summary: Model cost per completed task and end-to-end latency distributions from observed data and dated rates; keep unknowns unknown and never sum stage percentiles.

skills.name: rollout-and-operations
skills.title: Rollout and operations
skills.summary: Plan staged releases with cohorts, observations, stop conditions, rollback and ownership; plan only, never deploy.

skills.name: outcome-and-value-analysis
skills.title: Outcome and value analysis
skills.summary: State the outcome that matters as a falsifiable hypothesis, compare alternatives on the same criteria, and later judge observed outcomes without confusing association with effect.

skills.name: adversarial-challenge
skills.title: Adversarial challenge
skills.summary: Issue material challenges that each name a contested premise, counterevidence or gap, consequence and resolving test, within a bounded number of rounds.

skills.name: evidentiary-adjudication
skills.title: Evidentiary adjudication
skills.summary: Rule on evidence sufficiency and option comparison against frozen criteria; return unresolved or insufficient when the evidence cannot carry the claim; never decide by vote.

skills.name: delegated-authority
skills.title: Delegated authority
skills.summary: Apply a recorded human delegation to a versioned proposal: accept, reject, defer or request human approval; bind every acceptance to exact scope and version.

skills.name: security-and-privacy-review
skills.title: Security and privacy review
skills.summary: Review permission enforcement, trust boundaries, injection exposure, data scope inheritance, retention and egress; distinguish enforced controls from requested compliance.

skills.name: controlled-learning
skills.title: Controlled learning
skills.summary: Propose skill or workflow improvements from verified outcomes on a separate version with held-out checks and rollback; protected policy cannot self-modify.

skills.name: accessible-interaction-design
skills.title: Accessible interaction design
skills.summary: Design controls, feedback and correction paths that people can perceive, understand and operate, separating drafts, previews, confirmations and executed actions.
